description: I’m a nursing student, researcher, and innovation enthusiast from Saudi Arabia passionate about space science and AI. I have experience in research, innovation, and hackathons. I’m developing CosmoQuest AI, an interactive platform to explore SPHEREx observations and investigate celestial changes. I’m looking for teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, data analysis, astronomy, and web development. Let’s turn scientific ideas into a working prototype and explore the universe together! 🚀
